records.trigger: No approved verified employment evidence exists for a Classic staff row.
records.release_condition: Protected HR crosswalk supplies a unique verified identity.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve Classic USER_ID and rule outcome in protected provenance.

records.trigger: More than one Classic row claims the same verified employment identity.
records.release_condition: Reviewed many-source-to-one contract or distinct identities are confirmed.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve all source keys and evidence hashes.

records.trigger: A matching rung returns more than one renewed user.
records.release_condition: Exactly one target is approved or the match is rejected.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.blocking_scope: staff and all dependent actor links
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve candidate-count and comparison hashes only.

records.trigger: A normalized nonblank Classic username occurs more than once.
records.release_condition: Username removed from matching or corroborated by stronger approved evidence.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Do not publish the username.

records.trigger: Classic username is null or blank.
records.release_condition: No release requirement if stronger verified evidence exists; otherwise IDENTITY-001.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve blank-state only.

records.trigger: Source staff cannot pass an approved matching rung.
records.release_condition: Verified crosswalk evidence is approved.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Protected source key only.

records.trigger: Classic department reference is malformed or contradicts approved evidence.
records.release_condition: Valid department evidence is approved.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve source reference.

records.trigger: Valid Classic department lacks an approved Phase 2A target crosswalk.
records.release_condition: Department crosswalk resolves to one target department.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve source and crosswalk versions.

records.trigger: No unique evidence-backed historical specialty can be established.
records.release_condition: One specialty is verified or specialty remains explicitly absent.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve evidence classification, not raw names.

records.trigger: A nonzero numeric actor reference has no Classic users parent.
records.release_condition: A verified parent relationship is established or field-specific unknown use is approved.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve original actor reference in protected provenance.

records.trigger: A field-specific actor reference equals zero.
records.release_condition: Per-field rule routes to null, approved unknown, or quarantine.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve zero and relationship rule ID.

records.trigger: Free-text clinician evidence cannot be verified through employment evidence.
records.release_condition: Protected HR crosswalk establishes one actor or field remains provenance-only.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Never publish clinician text.

records.trigger: Candidate creation or mapping conflicts with target unique email/employee identifier or one-to-one link.
records.release_condition: Conflict is resolved without overwriting target identity fields.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Record only target record key in protected crosswalk.

records.trigger: Verified existing target user differs from Classic name/contact/department evidence.
records.release_condition: Conflict is acknowledged; existing target remains unchanged.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Store conflict flags/hashes only.

records.trigger: Classic password column is encountered.
records.release_condition: Always excluded; no value may leave the protected extraction boundary.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Record count only; never read into documentation output.

records.trigger: Classic CanAdd/CanEdit/CanDelete/CanPrint is encountered.
records.release_condition: Always excluded; no value may become a target authorization.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Record column/count only; never record values.

records.trigger: A historical-only or unknown identity has login, role, permission, notification, department-access, or privilege state.
records.release_condition: All prohibited states are zero and credentials are unusable.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Record assertion evidence without secrets.

records.category: Unknown actor not permitted for target field
records.trigger: A required target actor field prohibits Legacy Actor Unknown.
records.release_condition: Verified actor supplied or row/chain remains quarantined.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve source reference and dependency ID.

records.trigger: Actor failure invalidates the parent aggregate or dependent chain.
records.release_condition: Every required actor dependency in the chain is released.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve all source keys in protected provenance.

records.trigger: Classic schema/database/version/table/column fingerprint differs from the approved baseline.
records.release_condition: New fingerprint is independently reviewed and approved.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: No row extraction proceeds.

records.trigger: A row cannot be deterministically ordered, resumed, or hashed under its strategy.
records.release_condition: Stable extraction identity and reconciliation are restored.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve query/version/hash metadata.

records.trigger: A Doctor field is blank under a relationship-specific rule.
records.release_condition: Field-specific null/unknown/provenance route is approved.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Preserve blank-state only.

records.trigger: A normalized name appears to match but no verified employment evidence corroborates it.
records.release_condition: A stronger approved matching rung succeeds.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Store normalized comparison hash only.

records.trigger: Classic FullName cannot be unambiguously split into required target first/last names.
records.release_condition: Approved display-name components or historical-identity schema representation supplied.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Keep raw name protected; publish no name.

records.trigger: Installed target cannot represent a disabled non-login historical identity without a required credential/contact or runtime path.
records.release_condition: Reviewed Phase 3 representation contract is approved.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: No target row may be created in Phase 2B.

records.trigger: Rerun aggregate counts differ from the approved relationship snapshot without an approved delta window.
records.release_condition: Change is explained by approved extraction window and reconciled.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count in a mutually exclusive primary outcome and retain secondary reason code.
records.provenance_requirements: Store aggregate counts and hashes only.

records.trigger: Classic notification sender/recipient actor-like content is encountered.
records.manual_review: Privacy review only if later legal retention authority changes
records.release_condition: Remains excluded under D-209; a new explicit legal decision is required to change scope.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count fields/rows as excluded without exporting values.
records.provenance_requirements: Aggregate counts and source fingerprint only.

records.trigger: Excluded empty maternity actor/contact field becomes nonempty or source fingerprint changes.
records.release_condition: Changed scope is independently evidenced and approved.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Baseline row/nonblank counts must remain zero.
records.provenance_requirements: Aggregate count/fingerprint only; never export values.

records.trigger: Configuration/signature/private actor-like field has no approved staff destination.
records.release_condition: A separate approved configuration mapping explicitly classifies the field.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count as excluded/configuration evidence; no actor mapping.
records.provenance_requirements: Protected evidence or aggregate fingerprint; signatures never enter docs.

records.trigger: Actor-like MdfId has no evidenced user relationship.
records.release_condition: Semantics and parent predicate are evidenced and approved, or field remains excluded.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Current blank baseline counted; no actor attribution.
records.blocking_scope: field; nonblank drift blocks affected clinical extraction
records.provenance_requirements: Blank/nonblank counts and fingerprint only.

records.trigger: billing.CASH_ID is actor-like but contains only zero and has no evidenced parent semantics.
records.release_condition: An exact parent/predicate is evidenced or the field remains provenance-only.
records.reconciliation_treatment: All-zero baseline is counted; no user mapping.
records.blocking_scope: field; nonzero drift blocks billing extraction
records.provenance_requirements: Original value protected; aggregate counts only in docs.

records.trigger: A target field whose policy is PERMITTED uses the single Legacy Actor Unknown because no valid actor can be determined.
records.release_condition: Target field policy is PERMITTED, D-202 approval is cited, a field-specific reason is recorded, original source actor evidence is protected, and reconciliation passes.
records.reconciliation_treatment: Count separately by target field, source relationship, reason code and approval ID; never combine with prohibited uses.
records.provenance_requirements: Protected source reference, relationship ID, target field ID, D-202 approval ID and reason code.
